text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The time has finally come! Mile CS, 1600 
meters!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All the bloody efforts I have made thus 
far have brought me here today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, we'll increase the 
distance even further, to 2000m, 2,500m… 
on the way to the ultimate peak of the 
Bakushin Road!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And now, for the first step――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's this? I'm in the Senior class now, 
right? But, I'm still on the first step…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What, what? In the first place, what is 
the true meaning of Bakushin Road――
choice_data_list: L-let's just focus on the race first!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
choice_data_list:
Let's win and become the "Strongest 
Miler"!

Let's win and become the "Strongest 
Miler"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Roger that! Please imagine as if you're on 
the S.S. Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you just how much I've grown in 
these past three years―!
